stemMd: Which policy approach best fits the passage?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Remove every revision process to preserve perfect uniformity.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Assume all shared-access systems must fail regardless of evidence.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Copy only the published sanction schedule and expect the same result.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Treat participation as sufficient even when behaviour is unobservable.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Assess monitoring, legitimacy, membership boundaries and local conditions before adapting a rule.

explanationMd: The recommendation treats governance as a system of interacting conditions rather than a transferable isolated rule.

distractorRationale.a: Revisability is one potentially useful arrangement.
distractorRationale.b: Stable cases refute that inevitability claim.
distractorRationale.d: The passage gives reasons participation alone may not suffice.
